required_permissions: Read/search, selected-index and field discovery, and product-specific PIT create/delete on the approved namespace using a supported configured identity
Optional cluster/node/index statistics require independent monitor privileges; AWS SigV4 is outside this release

capabilities.name: metrics
capabilities.summary: Mapped Query DSL metrics, units, weighted statistics and terminal windows in the expanded elastic pack
capabilities.remaining: Provider-only TLS trials cover OpenSearch 2.19.0 and 3.3.0; qualify the complete controller/collector-to-archive workflow and managed deployments separately

capabilities.name: diagnostics
capabilities.summary: Scrubbed projected logs, errors, transactions and spans with concrete-index document identity
capabilities.remaining: Qualify actual Data Prepper/OTel field mappings and the complete retained-evidence workflow; provider pagination alone does not qualify durable retention

capabilities.name: trace_lookup
capabilities.summary: Observed trace IDs narrow approved queries and preserve correlation classification
capabilities.remaining: Qualify a live instrumented SUT, upstream sampling and missing ancestors across retained trace views

capabilities.name: run_header
capabilities.summary: Opt-in managed run-header propagation with authored-header conflict checks and frozen run scope
capabilities.remaining: Qualify deployed application ingestion of X-Apex-Test-Run and approved-origin redirect behavior with real indexed data

capabilities.name: esql
capabilities.summary: OpenSearch explicitly rejects Elastic ES|QL and does not translate it to PPL
capabilities.remaining: ES|QL is an Elasticsearch-only capability; OpenSearch PPL/SQL adapters are outside this release

capabilities.name: pagination
capabilities.summary: Product-specific PIT/search-after reads with configured sortable-ID fallback or native index/shard ties
capabilities.remaining: Provider-only 10,005-record TLS trials passed on the 2.19.0 fallback and 3.3.0 native paths; qualify multi-node outages and deployed durable quotas

capabilities.name: private_collector
capabilities.summary: Locally approved destinations and indices, sealed signed work, bounded spool replay and cleanup ownership
capabilities.remaining: Qualify an actual remote collector-to-vendor deployment, private DNS/TLS trust, restarts and controller failover

capabilities.name: component_health
capabilities.summary: Independently authorized OpenSearch cluster/node/index statistics with instantaneous measurement semantics
capabilities.remaining: Qualify deployed monitor roles; local vendor trials covered search while cluster health was forbidden. Prometheus-hosted observability metrics use the existing Prometheus source
